lines.x: South Korea is preparing a stock market stabilization fund following a 5.2% plunge in the Kospi index.
Shares of South Korean entertainment companies jumped by as much as 30% following the announcement of a new trade agreement with China.
The Bank of Korea is expected to raise its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% at its upcoming meeting, responding to headline CPI remaining at 2.8% year-on-year.
Asia-Pacific shares strengthened, led by South Korea, with the Kospi rising 2.9% in a rally that reports attribute to Nvidia's earnings performance.
